description: Declarations that each break one keyword of declaration.schema.json, or one of the three checks that complete it, with the issues of stage 3.

cases.description: A declaration that is an array.

issues.message: Expected object at (root), found array.

cases.description: A version written as a number, which stage 2 leaves to the schema.

issues.message: Expected string at /vocabulary, found number.

cases.description: A declaration without a version.

issues.message: The object at (root) lacks the required member 'vocabulary'.

cases.description: A units block that is a string.

issues.message: Expected array at /units, found string.

cases.description: A variables entry that is a string instead of an object.

issues.message: Expected object at /variables/y, found string.

cases.description: A unit without its columns.

issues.message: The object at /units/0 lacks the required member 'columns'.

cases.description: A misspelt 'nested_in' (the draft's bad2, without its id_scope).

issues.message: Unknown key 'nestedin' in the object at /units/0.

cases.description: A misspelt 'categoriesOrdered' in a field descriptor.

issues.message: Unknown key 'categoriesordered' in the object at /table/fields/0.

cases.description: The draft's example ex4 with its dyad block, which follows in a later vocabulary.

issues.message: Unknown key 'dyad' in the object at (root).

cases.description: The draft's example ex6 with its EEG block, which follows in a later vocabulary.

issues.message: Unknown key 'eeg' in the object at (root).

cases.description: An imputation block, which follows in a later vocabulary.

issues.message: Unknown key 'imputation' in the object at (root).

cases.description: An 'x-' extension key, which the draft allowed.

issues.message: Unknown key 'x-note' in the object at (root).

cases.description: A time zone in observation.time, which follows in a later vocabulary.

issues.message: Unknown key 'timezone' in the object at /observation/time.

cases.description: The draft's 'scheme' in an assignment entry.

issues.message: Unknown key 'scheme' in the object at /assignment/0.

cases.description: Categories on a field of type 'number'.

issues.message: The member 'categories' is not allowed in the object at /table/fields/0.

cases.description: An event level for an outcome that is not binary.

issues.message: The member 'event_level' is not allowed in the object at /variables/y.

cases.description: A trials column for a count outcome.

issues.message: The member 'trials' is not allowed in the object at /variables/y.

cases.description: A binomial outcome without its trials column.

issues.message: The object at /variables/y lacks the required member 'trials'.

cases.description: An exposure for an outcome that is not a count.

issues.message: The member 'exposure' is not allowed in the object at /variables/y.

cases.description: Bounds for a measurement other than bounded_score.

issues.message: The member 'bounds' is not allowed in the object at /variables/y.

cases.description: A bounded score without bounds.

issues.message: The object at /variables/y lacks the required member 'bounds'.

cases.description: The prediction goal, which follows after 1.0.

issues.message: The value at /goal must be 'confirmatory' or 'exploratory'.

cases.description: The estimand kind 'prediction', which follows after 1.0.

issues.message: The value at /estimands/0/kind must be 'total_effect', 'direct_effect' or 'association'.

cases.description: The draft's feature 'dyadic' (the draft's bad3).

issues.message: The value at /features/0 must be 'cluster_randomised', 'multisite', 'stepped_wedge', 'partially_nested', 'longitudinal', 'intensive_longitudinal', 'family', 'crossed_experiment', 'counterbalanced', 'trial_level', 'corpus' or 'observational'.

cases.description: The Frictionless type 'any', which is written by leaving the type out.

issues.message: The value at /table/fields/0/type must be 'string', 'integer', 'number', 'boolean', 'date' or 'datetime'.

cases.description: A data commitment that covers the outcome column, which only a results document records.

issues.message: The value at /provenance/data_commitment/covers must be 'data_file' or 'analysis_table'.

cases.description: A unit name that starts with a digit.

issues.message: The string at /units/0/name is not a valid name.

cases.description: An estimand term written with '*', which is not an interaction of the grammar.

issues.message: The string at /estimands/0/term is not a valid estimand term.

cases.description: 29 February of a year that is not a leap year, which matches the pattern but fails the day check in code.

issues.message: The string at /provenance/created is not a valid UTC timestamp.

cases.description: 29 February of 2100, which is divisible by 100 and not by 400.

issues.message: The string at /provenance/created is not a valid UTC timestamp.

cases.description: A creation time without the time of day.

issues.message: The string at /provenance/created is not a valid UTC timestamp.

cases.description: A title with a tab.

issues.message: The string at /title is not a valid single-line text.

cases.description: A column name with a line feed.

issues.message: The string at /units/0/columns/0 is not a valid column name.

cases.description: An inferred entry that is not a JSON Pointer.

issues.message: The string at /provenance/inferred/0 is not a valid JSON Pointer.

cases.description: A commitment digest in upper-case hexadecimal.

issues.message: The string at /provenance/data_commitment/digest is not a valid HMAC-SHA-256 digest.

cases.description: A quoted variable with a character outside the BMP, which matches the pattern of a term and is refused in code.

issues.message: The identifier at /estimands/0/term contains a character outside the Basic Multilingual Plane.

cases.description: An empty title.

issues.message: The string at /title has fewer than 1 characters.

cases.description: An empty column name.

issues.message: The string at /observation/key/0 has fewer than 1 characters.

cases.description: A title of 201 characters.

issues.message: The string at /title has more than 200 characters.

cases.description: A field name of 129 characters.

issues.message: The string at /table/fields/0/name has more than 128 characters.

cases.description: An empty units block, which must be left out instead.

issues.message: The array at /units has fewer than 1 items.

cases.description: Bounds with one value.

issues.message: The array at /variables/y/bounds has fewer than 2 items.

cases.description: Bounds with three values.

issues.message: The array at /variables/y/bounds has more than 2 items.

cases.description: A crossing of three units.

issues.message: The array at /crossings/0/units has more than 2 items.

cases.description: A feature listed twice.

issues.message: The item at /features/1 repeats an earlier item.

cases.description: A column listed twice in the observation key.

issues.message: The item at /observation/key/1 repeats an earlier item.

cases.description: A unit crossed with itself.

issues.message: The item at /crossings/0/units/1 repeats an earlier item.

cases.description: An empty variables block (E-verify e11).

issues.message: The object at /variables has fewer than 1 members.

cases.description: An empty observation block.

issues.message: The object at /observation has fewer than 1 members.

cases.description: An empty provenance block.

issues.message: The object at /provenance has fewer than 1 members.

cases.description: A variables key with a tab, which is not a column name.

issues.message: The key 'a\u0009b' in the object at /variables is not a valid column name.

cases.description: A variables key of 129 characters, reported by propertyNames alone.

issues.message: The key 'kkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkk...' in the object at /variables is not a valid column name.

cases.description: A nested unit without its id_scope (the draft's bad1).

issues.message: The member 'nested_in' in the object at /units/1 requires the member 'id_scope'.

cases.description: An id_scope without nested_in.

issues.message: The member 'id_scope' in the object at /units/0 requires the member 'nested_in'.

cases.description: A membership without nested_in.

issues.message: The member 'membership' in the object at /units/0 requires the member 'nested_in'.

cases.description: categoriesOrdered without categories.

issues.message: The member 'categoriesOrdered' in the object at /table/fields/0 requires the member 'categories'.

cases.description: Categories on a field without a type.

issues.message: The member 'categories' in the object at /table/fields/0 requires the member 'type'.

cases.description: A category that is a decimal number.

issues.message: Expected string, integer or object at /table/fields/0/categories/1, found number.

cases.description: A missing value written as a number.

issues.message: Expected string or object at /table/fields/0/missingValues/0, found number.
